shared_elements: faint horizontal incised line or band encircling the surface
justification: A shows an essentially undecorated vessel bearing only a faint horizontal incised line near its rim, while B shows a densely figured procession of standing human figures in profile-facing rows, each with elaborate headgear and held attributes, framed above and below by continuous rosette borders. The only correspondence is the universal device of a horizontal line/band running around the surface, which is far too generic to suggest any shared iconographic tradition; B has an entire figural repertoire that A wholly lacks.
